description: This file defines an immutable data class 'ColumnFilterData' used for representing filter criteria on data table columns within the Fineract project. It includes static factory methods for creating filter instances based on equality, range, or custom SQL operators.

classes.name: ColumnFilterData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing datatable data, used for filtering operations on columns with support for different filter types.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a ColumnFilterData instance representing an equality filter on the specified column.

methods.name: btw
methods.description: Creates a ColumnFilterData instance representing a 'between' filter with two values.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ColumnFilterData instance with a custom SqlOperator and multiple values.
